keywords: The Petitioner sought to quash the conviction and sentence under Sections 99 and 65 of the Air Force Act, on the grounds that defence of accidence and burden of proof had not been considered by the District Court Martial and Judge Advocate. Held - no iota of evidence to conclude or suggest accidental firing; Application dismissed without costs.
